notes: Masklings is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 MASKLINGS once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, or external mint or burn functions. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
